translationRules.translatesNeverRedefines: An adapter maps framework behavior onto a native surface. It never changes what a control means, only how it is expressed.
translationRules.noAuthorityOrigination: An adapter never becomes an authority. It cannot approve, cannot classify risk, and cannot resolve a source conflict.
translationRules.noProjectGovernance: An adapter carries no project-specific governance. Project rules live in the Profile, not the adapter.
translationRules.noStateInvention: An adapter may not invent, rename, merge, skip, or reorder a governed lifecycle state or gate.
translationRules.noIndependenceCollapse: An adapter may not collapse required independent steps into one invocation for convenience.

capabilityMap.translationNote: Framework work item maps to a GitHub Issue with labels for workType, riskClass, lifecycleState
State reflected as labels; GitHub never holds the authoritative state, the framework does
Slice work on feature branches; implementation role has VCS_WRITE_BRANCH only
PR review by a distinct reviewer; relabel-only does NOT satisfy independence — the reviewer must be a separate actor
VCS_MERGE denied to implementer; protection requires review + checks
This is where Step 17's declarative tool-permission matrix becomes ENFORCED
Framework deterministic checks run as required status checks
Evidence records link to CI run artifacts and check results
Release gate maps to a protected release; RELEASE_EXECUTE with approval only
No credentials, no gh CLI, egress 403 unauthenticated on this platform
capabilityMap.mitigation: Adapter is fully specified and unit-validated against a local simulated surface. Live validation is DEFERRED to owner execution or a credentialed environment. No GitHub integration is signed off as passing without real execution.
capabilityMap.riskAcceptor: John (owner) — must execute Steps 63-72/91/101/110 against real GitHub or provision a credentialed environment

capabilityMap.translationNote: secret_protection is a global non-waivable invariant; secrets must never enter this chat
capabilityMap.mitigation: Secrets bound in the owner's GitHub environment, never in framework artifacts or conversation. Adapter references secret NAMES only.

prohibitions: GitHub is an enforcement/translation surface, never a new authority
A merged PR is not acceptance; acceptance is the framework gate
Branch protection may not be configured to allow an implementer to self-approve
CI green is not release approval — release is a human gate

evidenceTranslation.rule: CI check results and PR artifacts are evidence records with reproduction commands. A check that did not run is NOT_EXAMINED, never PASS.

handoffTranslation.rule: Handoff = PR + linked issue + evidence links. Receiver refuses a PR missing required evidence rather than inferring.

lifecycleSyncRule: Issue/PR labels reflect the canonical state; a label change never drives a state change on its own.
